account_setup_tokens_terminal_state_chec.name: account_setup_tokens_terminal_state_check
account_setup_tokens_terminal_state_chec.value: not ("account_setup_tokens"."consumed_at" is not null and "account_setup_tokens"."revoked_at" is not null)

media_alt_text_check.name: media_alt_text_check
media_alt_text_check.value: "media"."is_decorative" or ("media"."alt_text" is not null and char_length(trim("media"."alt_text")) > 0)

places_non_draft_identity_check.name: places_non_draft_identity_check
places_non_draft_identity_check.value: "places"."status" = 'draft' or ("places"."name" is not null and char_length(trim("places"."name")) between 1 and 160 and "places"."city_id" is not null and "places"."category_id" is not null)

places_public_slug_check.name: places_public_slug_check
places_public_slug_check.value: "places"."status" not in ('published', 'unpublished', 'archived') or "places"."slug" is not null

places_coordinate_pair_check.name: places_coordinate_pair_check
places_coordinate_pair_check.value: ("places"."latitude" is null and "places"."longitude" is null) or ("places"."latitude" is not null and "places"."longitude" is not null)
